source: lanes/B-content/ef12-images.json + REPORT.md Task 4; anchors read from the current worktree files at HEAD (worktree clean apart from unrelated l10n/overrides changes)
apply: cd sites/ayurvedichealingvillage.com && node tools/apply-copy-plan.mjs <this file> --check   (then without --check)
verification: All 42 entries passed `node tools/apply-copy-plan.mjs <plan> --check` (every count matched; 6 files would change: seven-informational-data.js, reader25b-family-data.js, reader25a-family-data.js, article-family-data.js, image-alt-map.json, image-alt-seen.json). An in-memory apply re-parsed all 6 files as valid JSON. /learn-more-about-yoga/ (identical src+alt+ptr to the live-to-100 image) stays unchanged. The ALT plan (alternateEntries swapped in for the portrait yoga card) also passed --check.
anchoring: Every entry's old string contains the image src (or, for the article figure, the sourceUrl carrying the unique filename) AND the old alt, exactly as serialised in the file. /ayurveda-treatment/ entries also include the block ptr, because shifted alts and the 13 identical placeholder objects make src+alt ambiguous. Swaps replace the whole image object (src, alt, width, height, sourceUrl and recordedOriginalSha256 from gallery-family-data.js, plus an 'ef12' provenance key that the l10n extractor ignores via its ^ef\d{2}$ rule).
designFlags: Januvasti and Netratharpanam replacements are portrait (840x1200) in a list of 600x400 landscape cards. They are set to width 600 / height 857, so they match the column width but each card is about twice as tall. Landscape alternatives named by the audit but NOT used: /ahv/assets/img/Approach-of-Arthiritis.webp (580x386: dough rings on the legs, therapist standing) and /ahv/assets/img/eye2.webp (523x348: eye dough rings, no oil visible).

/new-to-yoga/ c0f307 replacement c3231a3e is portrait in a landscape card grid, and it is the same photo as the left panel of the 20f33c6f replacement two cards earlier. Recommend alternateEntries[0] (40ce7b7d, landscape, visually verified by this lane).

emailDraft.subject: Photo request: 8 therapy photographs for the Ayurveda Treatment page (KTAHV Palakkad)
emailDraft.body:
Hello team,

The Ayurveda Treatment page on ayurvedichealingvillage.com lists therapies that have no genuine photograph. They currently show a stand-in picture of Kairali bowls, which we are removing. We need one photograph per therapy below, shot at the Palakkad hospital (not the HO centre). Each photo is a 3:2 landscape card: please deliver 1800x1200 px (minimum 1200x800). The per-shot spec (subject, action, environment, camera, lens, lighting, style) is attached. The treatment team and Dr. Deepu John will confirm each procedure set-up before the shoot. For Matravasti and Kashayavasthi, please photograph the preparation only, with no patient in frame.

Therapies: Urovasti, Kavalagraham, Gandoosham, Karnapoornam, Dhoompanam, Thalam, Matravasti, Kashayavasthi. Conditional: Greevavasti (only if the treatment team rejects the existing candidate photo) and Netradhara (only if the team confirms the current photo shows Netra Tarpanam).

Thank you.

spec7.Subject: Warm medicated oil held in a dough ring built on the chest of a patient lying on their back
spec7.Action: A therapist pours warm oil from a brass vessel into the dough ring on the chest; the patient is draped from the waist down
spec7.Environment: KTAHV Palakkad treatment room: exposed brick wall, dark wooden droni (treatment table), brass vessels. spec7.Lighting: Warm soft window light from one side plus a low bounce fill; no on-camera flash; match the warm tone of the existing Abhyangam/Kativasti photos
spec7.Style: Documentary clinical-care photography: calm, dignified, no text, no props that are not part of the procedure, patient modesty preserved (draped), no identifiable patient face unless a signed consent form is on file
